settings.intro: The alarms live in the speakers, not in Homey — they ring even when Homey is off. Changes here take effect in the Sonos app immediately.
settings.soundHint: The sound can be the built-in Sonos chime, one of your favourites, or a Sonos playlist. To use something that is not listed, star it in the Sonos app first.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete this alarm? It is removed from Sonos too.
settings.connectionHint: The app talks to your speakers directly over the network. No Sonos account is involved. Leave the address empty to let the app find a speaker itself.
